text.p: These are the main headlines of the news reported by Radio Latvia at noon on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- President Gunitis Ulmanis meets parliament factions today to dicuss the slow pace of non-citizen naturalisation.
- LNNK dicusses possible candidates to the defence post, following sacking of the previous minister Andrejs Krastinsh amid a fuel purchase scandal.
- Teachers will decide on what steps to take if their demand for pay increases are not met.
- Expolat exhibition takes place in Russia, Novgorod with some 30 companies participating. A similar event is planned in November in Kaliningrad.
